info.title: F-Grade Corporate AI CRM API
info.description: Live Zoho CRM records and server-side metrics for the F-Grade Corporate AI Agent. Semantic concepts such as converted, conversion rate, revenue, pipeline, and top owner are business operations, not CRM field names.
info.x-copilot-studio-tool-description: Use this single tool for every CRM question. Send the user's natural-language question unchanged in the question property. The backend owns intent detection, module selection, Zoho field mapping, filters, owner resolution, date ranges, pagination, aggregation, conversion logic, and answer generation. Do not construct module names, field names, owner IDs, filters, COQL, date criteria, or conversion logic in Copilot Studio. Do not call an alternate structured CRM operation. Never emit a Leads field named Converted; Converted is not a CRM API field. Conversion questions must remain natural language and be handled by the backend.
info.x-copilot-studio-input-policy: The question property is required and must contain the user's complete natural-language CRM request. Ask a clarifying question in conversation when the user's request is ambiguous; do not guess CRM fields or criteria.

post.description: Resolves record, count, aggregate, grouped, and lead-conversion questions and executes the required filtered Zoho CRM query or queries.

200.description: Complete answer and requested CRM data returned by the backend for the user's question.

400.description: Invalid question, field, date, owner, or aggregate request.

502.description: Zoho CRM configuration, authentication, or query failure.

AssistantRequest.description: Natural-language CRM question. Send the complete user request in question.

question.description: The complete natural-language CRM question provided by the user.

conversation_id.description: Optional stable conversation identifier used to resolve natural-language follow-up questions.

response.description: Complete answer and requested CRM data returned by the backend for the user's question.
Complete answer explaining why the backend could not answer the user's question.
